props.heading: Indoor Plant Care Guide
props.description: Light, watering, and seasonal notes for three easy houseplants

props.title: Keep plants away from heaters
props.description: Heaters and heating vents dry out the air and soil quickly. Keep every plant at least 1 metre from radiators, vents, and hot drafts.

props.textMarkdown:
**Spring:** Resume regular watering and fertilize monthly as new growth appears.

**Summer:** Water more often for pothos and peace lily; keep snake plant on the drier side.

**Autumn:** Reduce watering and stop fertilizing as growth slows.

**Winter:** Water sparingly, keep plants away from cold drafts and heating vents.

props.title: Tip
props.description: Check soil moisture with a finger two inches deep before watering any plant.

props.textMarkdown:
- **Pothos:** Bright indirect light. Leggy growth or pale leaves mean it needs more light.
- **Snake plant:** Tolerates low light. Bright indirect light gives faster growth.
- **Peace lily:** Medium indirect light. Direct sun scorches the leaves.
